ValidationRule.description: Date Account Inactivated must be current or past date. It cannot be in the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType_Name__c = "CLAS - RM") && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Account_Inactivated__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Account_Inactivated__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Account_Inactivated__c) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Account_Inactivated__c)) || DATEVALUE(Date_Account_Inactivated__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Account_Inactivated__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Account_Inactivated__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Account_Inactivated__c)> TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Account Inactivated must be current or past date. It cannot be in the Future.
